translation: Qibo says: On the first day the great yang receives it, therefore there is pain of the head and nape and stiffness of the loins and spine. On the second day the yangming receives it; yangming governs the flesh, and its vessel flanks the nose and connects with the eyes, therefore there is body heat, eye pain, dry nose, and inability to sleep. On the third day the shaoyang receives it; shaoyang governs the gallbladder, and its vessel follows the flanks and connects with the ears, therefore there is pain of the chest and flanks and deafness. When the three yang channels and collaterals have all received the disease but have not yet entered the viscera, therefore one can sweat and it stops.
